name: @pull-fm/db
//dependencies: scripts/migrate.mjs does `import pg from "pg"` and this package declared nothing, so the migration runner resolved the driver only by accident of whatever a previous install happened to leave at the workspace root. A clean `pnpm install` puts nothing there, and load/bin/stack-up.sh then dies at step 3 with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND, which reads as a broken load stack rather than as a missing dependency.
Pinned to the same range apps/bff uses so the workspace resolves one copy of the driver, not two.
